title: AI/ML Platform & Retrieval Engineer
description_raw: Join our AI Platform team to build the core foundation for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings pipelines, and graph-grounded agentic workflows. You will implement deterministic evaluation harnesses, production vector search indexes, and high-throughput model serving pipelines backed by Google Gemini, Ollama, and open-source models.

requirements.requirement_text: 3+ years deploying LLM pipelines, RAG systems, or vector databases in production
Proficiency with Python, asynchronous programming, and embedding models
Experience with knowledge graphs (Neo4j/Cognee) or hybrid dense-sparse retrieval
Understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination bounds, and prompt safety
